summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 22, 2026 news release announcing a variation to the special resolution on its Articles and postponement of its annual general and special meeting from September 25 to October 2, 2026, with the proxy deadline extended to September 30, 2026. The amendments, tied to a potential Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing, raise shareholder quorum from 5% to 25% and set board quorum at one-half of directors. This is a routine meeting notice and governance-circular matter, not a special situation.
